text: The UI Designer can design a menu for all these functions.
The current look-and-feel and usability of remote controls are disliked by users and are hard to learn, with remotes often getting lost in rooms.

The target group will be sixteen to forty; there will be two groups of functions (simple for broad public and advanced for younger users); the product must include corporate identity with a logo and consistent colours, and teletext and the newsflash feature will not be used.

The PM will write the meeting minutes; the UI Designer will group the functions into two groups: display functions and basic functions; the UI Designer will compile a list of the functions to be on the LCD screen menu; the ID will integrate the channel-changing functionality into the design.
